title: Scanned page docx 001
notes: scanned-page emulation: a 300px-wide synthetic raster (off-white paper gray, gray pseudo-text word bars, seeded per-pixel noise) rendered with PIL and embedded as a real PNG media part via python-docx add_picture at 6.5in full-page width, with one caption line below. The image has NO text layer (bars, not glyphs), so there is no OCR truth inside the picture: reference_text is the caption ONLY — the honest near-None case; the noise seed derives from the fixture-seeded ctx.rng.
